outcome.technical: plugins/audit/scripts/governance/_floor_guard.py: (1) TEST_PREFIX = "test", one fixed prefix rather than a table, because unittest's default loader (testMethodPrefix) and pytest's default python_functions agree on it and both compare case-sensitively. _tests_only() filters _definitions() to names whose last segment starts with it, top level or method; _compare_definitions compares only those, so the rename and declared rules work as before over tests only. _uncompared() adds a notRead entry {path, move: definition-changed, reason} for a Python test file the diff modifies when neither copy defines a test* and the module's ast.dump differs (a comment-only edit gives nothing). notRead entries now all carry `move` (None = file not read for any move); the CLEAN basis counts only the move-None entries as unread and the tail names the definition-unread files apart. (2) SUPPRESSIONS gained a third column, a codes pattern matched where the marker ends (noqa `: E402,F401`, type: ignore `[code]`, eslint-disable rule list, istanbul ignore word, nosemgrep `: ids`, Stryker mutators; @ts-ignore, @ts-expect-error, gitleaks:allow, pragma: no cover have none). _suppression_keys() turns a comment into (kind, code) keys and a blanket marker into the single key (kind, None), which is its own code and never a wildcard. Suppressions left _pair: _new_suppressions() reports a tree suppression when one of its keys is in no comment of the base copy and is not accepted (a file new to the diff has no base, so every key is new). Skips and stubs keep the old exact-text-then-kind pairing. find_moves(..., accepted=()) is new and optional. Each accepted entry is a string written the way its comment would be (`noqa: E402`, `type: ignore[attr-defined]`, `eslint-disable no-console`, `noqa` for blanket) and is read by the same tables, anchored at the entry's start and consumed whole. It matches by kind plus exact code: surrounding blanks and blanks between codes are ignored, `noqa:E402` is the same entry, `noqa: F401, E402` accepts both codes, the marker and the code are case-sensitive, and a prefix is a different code. Pinned near misses that do NOT match `# noqa: E402`: `noqa: E40`, `noqa: e402`, `type: ignore[E402]` (fm30). An entry the tables cannot read whole (`NOQA: E402`, a bare `E402`, `noqa: E402 extra`, or one string passed in place of a sequence) makes the answer could-not-tell before any file is read, so it never silently matches nothing (fc13). Docstring rewritten for both narrowings and their limits. tests/test__floor_guard.py: _run takes accepted (passed only when given; a TypeError from a module refusing it becomes a failing result, not a crash); _moves tolerates that result. New sections `_definitions` (fa12, fa13, fa14, fm24, fm25, fa19) and `_suppressions` (fa15, fm26, fm27, fm28, fa16, fm29, fa17, fm30, fm31, fa18, fm32), plus fc13 and fa20. fa5 relabelled to the new rule.
